breakdown.description: Shallow-water wave speed c = sqrt(g h) applies only when h ≪ λ (e.g., h < λ/20). For deep water, wave speed depends on wavelength, not depth.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to correct the user's incorrect formula. The user provided the shallow-water wave speed formula (c = sqrt(g h)) for a deep-water wave scenario. The Agent should have corrected this to the appropriate deep-water formula (c = sqrt(g λ / (2π))) as indicated in the ground truth. Instead, the Agent repeated the user's incorrect instruction and used the shallow-water formula.
